# API reference

<!-- Generated by `php bin/api-reference.php > docs/api-reference.md`. Do not edit by hand: a test fails when it is out of date. -->

The **public API**: every public method that is not marked `@internal`. Anything else may change in any release (see [API stability](api-stability.md)). Fluent methods return the object, so they chain.

## Plugin (`DrilldownNavPlugin`)

Registered on a panel with `->plugin(DrilldownNavPlugin::make()->…)`.

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `static current(): ?static` | The plugin of the panel being served, if that panel uses it. |
| `static get(): static` | The plugin instance registered on the current panel (throws if the panel does not use it). |
| `static make(): static` | Create the plugin to register on a panel: `->plugin(DrilldownNavPlugin::make()->items(...))`. |
| `accordion(bool $accordion = true): static` | Only one inline section open at a time within the same parent (opening one closes its siblings). |
| `childDisplay(ChildDisplay $display): static` | Default for items with children: open a new level (drilldown, the default) or expand in place (inline). Override per item with `->inline()` / `->drilldown()`. |
| `flatten(int $limit = 300, int $maxDepth = 6): array` | The whole menu as a flat list of pages the current user may see: label, URL, the labels of the levels above it (trail) and its depth. For "search all levels", command palettes, a mobile bottom bar (filter `depth === 0`) or tests. |
| `items(Closure\|array $items): static` | Pass a closure (recommended): it is evaluated once per request, so menus can depend on the current user, tenant or database state. Items built outside a closure live as long as the worker does, which is fine for static menus only. |
| `pinnable(bool $pinnable = true, bool $database = false, ?string $model = null): static` | A "Pin this page" toggle, and a "Pinned" list at the top of the top level. |
| `pollBadges(?string $interval = '30s'): static` | Re-render the sidebar every $interval (e.g. '30s', '2m'), so badges and record titles stay current without a page load. Livewire pauses polling in background tabs. Null turns it off. For changes you know about, dispatch Filament's `refresh-sidebar` event instead (e.g. `$this->dispatch('refresh-sidebar')`). |
| `recent(int $limit = 5): static` | A "Recent" list of the last $limit pages visited (per browser and user) at the top level. 0 turns it off. |
| `searchable(bool $searchable = true, int $minItems = 0, bool $allLevels = false, ?string $shortcut = '/'): static` | A search box above the menu that filters the items already on screen (the current level and inline sections) as you type. With $minItems, it appears only when at least that many items are listed. |

## Menu items (`NavItem`)

Built with `NavItem::make()` and friends; returned from `->items(fn () => [...])`.

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `static fromFilamentNavigation(?Closure $filter = null): array` | Everything Filament would show in its own sidebar (`$navigationGroup`, `$navigationParentItem`, `$navigationSort`, badges, `shouldRegisterNavigation()`, access checks), as drill-down items. Mix it with hand-written items; use $filter to leave items out (return false). |
| `static heading(Htmlable\|string $label): static` | A non-clickable section heading ("Manage", "Reports" ...), like Filament's group labels. Combine with ->divider() for a line above it. |
| `static make(Htmlable\|string $label): static` | A plain menu item with this label. |
| `static page(string $page): static` | A Filament Page: label, icon, URL and access come from the page class. |
| `static resource(string $resource, array $parameters = array ( )): static` | A Filament Resource: label, icon, list URL and access come from the resource class. Pass URL parameters for a nested resource, e.g. `['project' => $project]`. |
| `activeIcon(BackedEnum\|Htmlable\|string\|null $icon): static` | Icon shown while the item is the current page. |
| `activeOn(Closure\|array $urls): static` | More URLs where this item counts as the current page, matched like its own URL (by prefix). For pages that belong to the item but live elsewhere, e.g. a list at /agents/1/sources whose records open at /agents/1/knowledge/{id}. Only items with a URL use them. |
| `activeWhen(Closure $condition): static` | Marks the item as the current page whenever $condition returns true, whatever the URL: for pages the URL cannot place, e.g. `fn () => request()->routeIs('reports.*')` or a tab in the query string. It counts as an exact URL match; if another item matches the URL exactly, the deeper of the two wins. Evaluated at most once per request; only items with a URL use it. |
| `badge(Closure\|string\|null $badge, Closure\|array\|string\|null $color = null): static` | A badge next to the label (a string, or a closure evaluated on each render), with an optional color. |
| `children(Closure\|array $children): static` | The items below this one: a list, or a closure evaluated at most once per request, only when needed. |
| `defaultExpanded(bool $expanded = true): static` | For inline items: start expanded even when the current page is not inside it. |
| `divider(bool $divider = true): static` | Draw a separator line above this item. |
| `drilldown(): static` | Open a new level for the children (the default), whatever the plugin's default display is. |
| `header(Htmlable\|Closure\|string\|null $header): static` | Replaces the default header (Back link and title) above the level this item opens, e.g. with a card and a switcher. Rendered as given: an Htmlable (a view) as HTML, a string as escaped text. The header then owns the way back, so include a link to the parent level yourself. |
| `icon(BackedEnum\|Htmlable\|string\|null $icon): static` | The icon shown next to the label (a Heroicon name, enum case or Htmlable). |
| `ignoreRecordKeys(Closure\|array $keys): static` | URL segments after this item's URL that are pages, not record keys ("create" by default). |
| `inline(bool $inline = true): static` | Show the children expanded in place under this item (click to expand/collapse) instead of opening a new level. |
| `limit(int $max, ?string $moreUrl = null): static` | Show at most $max children (the one containing the current page is always kept), followed by a "View all (N)" link to $moreUrl, or a "+N more" note without one. For menus with hundreds of entries. All children still take part in URL matching; only the display is shortened. |
| `record(Closure $menu): static` | The menu shown while the visitor is inside ONE record of this item: the URL segment right after this item's URL is treated as the record key. |
| `recordHeader(Closure $header): static` | Like header(), for the level of ONE record of this item (see record()): the closure gets the record. |
| `recordPages(?array $pages = null): static` | The record menu, built from the resource's own record pages: View, Edit, pages managing related records, custom pages on `/{record}/…`. Labels, icons, badges and access come from each page (`getNavigationLabel()`, `getNavigationIcon()`, `canAccess()` …), exactly as Filament builds a record's sub-navigation. Pass page classes to choose and order them; by default every page whose route needs only the record, in the order of `getPages()`. Only for items made with resource(). |
| `recordTitleUsing(Closure $title): static` | The title shown above a record's menu (default: the record cast to text). |
| `resolveRecordUsing(Closure $resolver): static` | How the record key in the URL becomes a record for `record()` menus (return null when there is none). |
| `url(?string $url): static` | Where the item links to, and the URL prefix that makes it the current item. |
| `visible(Closure\|bool $condition = true): static` | Show the item only when this is true (a bool, or a closure evaluated on each render). |

## Record menus declared on the resource (`HasDrilldownRecordMenu`)

Implement this interface on a Filament Resource to declare the menu shown inside one of its records, next to the resource itself. `NavItem::resource(YourResource::class)` then uses it with no extra config.

| Method | What it does |
|---|---|
| `static drilldownRecordMenu(Model $record): array` | The items of the menu shown inside this record. |

## Display mode (`ChildDisplay`)

| Case | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ChildDisplay::Drilldown` | Click opens a new level in the sidebar, with a Back link (the plugin's signature behaviour). |
| `ChildDisplay::Inline` | Children expand in place under the item, with a guide line (the classic tree/accordion). |

## Render hooks (`DrilldownNavHook`)

See [Render hooks](render-hooks.md). Every hook is scoped to the id of the panel being rendered.

| Constant | Where it renders |
|---|---|
| `DrilldownNavHook::NAV_START` | First thing inside the navigation (above the search box). |
| `DrilldownNavHook::NAV_END` | Last thing inside the navigation (below the list, search note and shortcuts). |
| `DrilldownNavHook::HEADER_BEFORE` | Before the Back link and title of a level (only on levels that have them). |
| `DrilldownNavHook::HEADER_AFTER` | After the Back link and title of a level. |
| `DrilldownNavHook::LIST_BEFORE` | Between the header/search and the list of items. |
| `DrilldownNavHook::LIST_AFTER` | Right after the list of items. |
